verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official CLI (documented at modal.com/docs/reference/cli) with commands for running commands/shells inside containers and managing/connecting to running containers, directly supporting sandbox and agentic workflows alongside SDKs used for AI agents. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on review of the CLI itself (community evidence focuses on SDK/gRPC usage rather than CLI specifically) and no deeper documentation of CLI's AI-native-specific features beyond basic container/sandbox management.
